channel.description: RSS-Feed für die Quelle 'TechCrunch AI' (Kategorie: Tech & AI).

item.title: Ex-Ramp engineers raise $20M for platform Melius after scrapping their first product
item.description: Instead of helping marketers manage and optimize ad spend, the company is focusing on building the tools that generate the creative assets and campaigns.

item.title: How AI decision models could change content moderation
item.description: On Tuesday, Musubi announced a lightweight decision model made for real-time moderation called PolicyLM-1.7B, released with open weights.

item.title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
item.description: Nvidia-backed Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO, led by Coatue and Blackstone.

item.title: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
item.description: Personal AI agents promise to shop, book flights, and make reservations for you. But deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses are getting in the way, leaving consumers caught in the middle. A new standard aims to help.

item.title: Hark releases an AI personal assistant with a focus on privacy
item.description: The AI lab's personal assistant is an operating system from the future designed to compete with Muse, Dots, and Instinct.

item.title: Mirror Particle is building a ‘world model’ of human behavior
item.description: Mirror Particle will launch at TechCrunch Disrupt's Startup Battlefield 200 with a world model built from scratch to predict human behavior, arguing that LLM role-play falls short for market research and brand strategy.

item.title: Anthropic is giving startups a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in credits
item.description: "We created this program because we believe the benefits of AI will reach most people through the companies that build on top of models, rather than through the models alone."

item.title: LibreOffice says ‘no AI’ is now a software feature
item.description: The maker of the open source document editor says it has no plans to add AI to its software's default configuration, citing user privacy.

item.title: Mistral’s new 1T model aims to leapfrog closed and open rivals
item.description: French AI lab Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, a new large multimodal model aiming to leapfrog both American and Chinese rivals.

item.title: Pinterest’s AI now turns beauty Pins into action plans
item.description: Pinterest’s new AI-powered Beauty Guides translate hair and nail Pins into salon terminology, with estimated costs, appointment times, and maintenance needs.

item.title: Get all your questions answered at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: The full breakout session agenda revealed
item.description: Get all of your scaling and tech questions answered at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Here's the full breakout session agenda, happening October 13-15 in San Francisco. Register now to join and save up to $100, and get a second pass at 50% off.
